result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculations: on the left, spherical-trigonometric relations between angles p, q, r and their indexed variants (half-angle tangent/sine formulas, with sketches of quadrilaterals and triangles); on the right, algebraic manipulation of the solutions x_n, y_n of a Pell-type equation involving \sqrt{D} and the units t_n + u_n\sqrt{D}.
